idea.title: SchemaSpy — Database schema visualizer and documentation generator

plan.tagline: Turn any database into interactive docs in seconds.
plan.problem: Developers waste hours manually documenting database schemas or using complex tools that require setup and internet access.
plan.solution: A lightweight CLI tool that scans your local database (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL via CLI tools) and generates a clean, searchable HTML/Markdown documentation file instantly—no internet, no config, no bloat.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small businesses managing databases who need quick, offline schema documentation without DevOps overhead.
mvp_features: Export to JSON/CSV for further processing
plan.demo_script: Run `schemaspy --demo` to generate a sample schema doc for a fake e-commerce database with tables like users, products, and orders, showing relationships and sample data—all offline with no setup.
plan.phuket_angle: Thai small businesses (e.g., hotels, tour operators) using SQLite for local inventory/booking systems can generate instant schema docs for new hires or audits without cloud dependencies.
